PLAN "12-Week Prenatal Strength Program - Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain lean mass, safe strength progression, and core stability throughout pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & safety":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        core:
          plank 3x20 seconds rpe 4
          dead_bug 3x10 each side
        cardio_session:
          walking 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & safety":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        core:
          side_plank 3x20 seconds per side
          dead_bug 3x12
        cardio_session:
          cycling 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & safety":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          rowing 12 minutes
        core:
          pallof_press 3x10 each side
          bicycle_crunch 3x15
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & safety":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          elliptical 15 minutes
        core:
          dead_bug 3x12
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression & intensity ramp with upper press & core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
        core:
          pallof_press 3x12 each side
          leg_raise 3x10
        cardio_session:
          walking 12 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_openers 60 seconds
          shoulder_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression & intensity ramp with upper press & core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
        core:
          side_plank 3x25 seconds per side
          dead_bug 3x12
        cardio_session:
          cycling 16 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_m mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression & intensity ramp with upper press & core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
        cardio_session:
          row_in_place 12 minutes
        core:
          pallof_press 3x12 each side
          bicycle_crunch 3x15
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
          upper_back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression & intensity ramp with upper press & core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
        core:
          dead_bug 3x12
          reverse_crunch 3x12
        cardio_session:
          rowing 12 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Consistency & safe load increase with core focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
        core:
          side_plank 3x30 seconds per side
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8
        cardio_session:
          walking 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Consistency & safe load increase with core focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
        core:
          pallof_press 3x12 each side
          leg_raise 3x12
        cardio_session:
          cycling 18 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Consistency & safe load increase with core focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7.0 rest 90 seconds
        cardio_session:
          row 12 minutes
        core:
          leg_raise 3x12
          bicycle_crunch 3x20
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Taper & recovery focus with core maintenance":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        core:
          plank 3x30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12
        cardio_session:
          walking 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          full_body_relax_stretch 120 seconds

NUTRITION PLAN
  GOALS
    - Support fetal development, maternal energy, and lean mass preservation
    - Maintain hydration; support iron, calcium, vitamin D, folate, and omega-3 intake
  GUIDING PRINCIPLES
    - Calorie: moderate energy balance to support pregnancy and activity; adjust after 20 weeks per clinician guidance
    - Protein: 1.6–1.8 g/kg/day target
    - Carbohydrates: emphasis on whole-food sources; fiber 25–35 g/day
    - Fats: include healthy fats; DHA 200–300 mg/day
    - Micronutrients: iron, calcium, vitamin D, folate, iodine, choline; prenatal multivitamin
    - Hydration: 2.2–3.0 L/day
  DAILY STRUCTURE
    - Breakfast: protein-rich + complex carbs + healthy fats
    - Lunch: protein + fiber + colorful veggies + whole grains
    - Snack: protein + fruit or veggie + healthy fat
    - Dinner: protein + veggies + whole grains or starchy carb
    - Optional: small protein-rich snack before bed
  SAMPLE MACRO RANGES
    - Protein: 0.9–1.2 g/kg per meal across 3–4 meals
    - Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day
    - Fats: 0.5–1.0 g/kg/day
  NUTRIENT FOCUS AREAS
    - Iron, Vitamin C for absorption, Calcium, Vitamin D, DHA/EPA, Folate, Fiber
  MEAL SUGGESTIONS
    - Breakfast: Greek yogurt + berries + chia + oats
    - Lunch: chicken quinoa bowl with vegetables
    - Snack: apple + almond butter
    - Dinner: salmon or tofu + brown rice + broccoli + avocado
    - Pre-bed: cottage cheese or protein smoothie
  FLUIDS AND CAFFEINE
    - Water 2.2–3.0 L
    - Caffeine <200 mg/day
  FOOD SAFETY
    - Avoid high-mercury fish; food handling
  SUPPLEMENTATION
    - Prenatal vitamin; consider iron status if advised
  ADAPTATIONS FOR PREGNANCY
    - No supine after week 16
    - Nausea adjustments; hydration
  MEASUREMENT & ADJUSTMENTS
    - Track weight gain per guidelines
    - Adjust portions for energy and recovery
  NOTES
    - OB clearance required
    - Consult dietitian if needed

CARDIO
  - Modalities used: walking, cycling, rowing, elliptical
  - Integrated into weekly plan as 12–18 minutes in Phase 2–3 and variable in Phase 1
  - Emphasize moderate intensity; avoid high-impact or contact activities

CORE
  - Implemented throughout Phase 1–3 with progressive challenges
  - Include planks, dead_bug, pallof_press, side_plank, leg_raise, bicycle_crunch, hip stability movements as indicated

UPPER BODY PRESSING
  - Incline_press and bench_press incorporated in Phase 2 with progressive loads
  - Maintain form and scapular control; avoid overhead overhead pressing beyond comfort if needed

PEAK WEEK (Week 12)
  - No 1RM testing; use submaximal technique-focused checks
  - If OB clinician approves, perform light technique assessment with conservative loads and RPE 6–7

EXERCISE VOCABULARY
